title: 1988 Toyota 4Runner
oneLine: I restored my 1985 4Runner and the pickup beside it, doing the engine swap, the fabrication and the suspension work myself.

hero.alt: The 4Runner front three quarter in a workshop, matte black with the weathered Mount Fuji and rising sun livery down the side, on a lift and BFGoodrich all terrains

intake.question: What is it, in one sentence?
intake.hint: The four vehicles, years and models, and what you have done to each in one line apiece.
intake.draft: Complete vehicle restoration featuring engine swap, custom fabrication, and suspension engineering.

intake.question: Role, timeline, status
intake.hint: How long you have been running them, and how many are on the road right now.

intake.question: What made it hard?
intake.hint: Parts availability, rust, budget, working outside, or diagnosing without a scan tool.

intake.question: What did you decide, and what did you reject?
intake.hint: One repair where you chose the harder correct fix over the quick one.

intake.question: What number can you put on it?
intake.hint: Combined mileage, years owned, money spent, longest single repair.

intake.question: What broke, and what did you do?
intake.hint: The worst breakdown and how you got home.

intake.question: What media do you have?
intake.hint: All four together if you can manage it. That single photo does more than any paragraph.

intake.question: What would you do differently?
intake.hint: Two sentences. Not self criticism, a design judgement you would make differently now.
